catalog_notes: The platform catalog (platform_solutions) holds 17 Solutions: 10 are 'available', 1 is 'setup_required', 1 is 'on_request' and 5 are 'coming_soon'.

All nine site slugs match an available catalog Solution: hr=hr-management, attendance=attendance-leave, payroll=payroll-workforce, facility=facility-management, assets=asset-management, maintenance=preventive-maintenance, procurement=procurement, inventory=inventory-spares, finance=finance-expenses.

Missing from the site: 'Work Orders & Maintenance' (work-orders-maintenance) is a tenth available catalog Solution. It maps to the same 'facilities' module as Facility Management and opens the same screens, so it is a second catalog entry for the same functions rather than extra functions.
Missing from the site: 'UAE eInvoicing' (uae-einvoicing) is a separate catalog Solution with status setup_required. Only a sandbox connector exists; it must not be presented as available.

Missing from the site: 'Custom Solutions' (on_request) and five coming_soon entries with no working screens: Property Management, Fleet Management, CRM & Sales, Projects & Tasks, Advanced Reports & Analytics.
Name difference: the catalog calls the payroll Solution 'Payroll & Workforce' (الرواتب والقوى العاملة); the site calls it 'Payroll'.

Grouping difference: the leave screens are gated by the HR module, not the attendance module. Attendance & Leave includes the HR and attendance modules, and Payroll includes the HR and payroll modules, so both also open the HR screens. Leave functions are therefore listed under both hr and attendance.
Grouping difference: the Owner/Client Portal is a technical module (client-portal) with no catalog Solution row. docs/PRODUCT_STATUS.md lists it as available; it is listed here under facility.

Grouping difference: the workspace launcher shows only four tiles (Human Resources, Facilities Management, Finance & Procurement, Owner Portal). Assets, Preventive Maintenance, Procurement, Inventory and Payments are menu items inside the Facilities sidebar, each gated by its own module.
Dependency: the preventive-maintenance module depends on the assets module, and generated work orders are worked on in the Work Orders screen, which needs the facilities module.

Facility Management is documented as including basic invoicing, but the invoice creation screen is gated by the finance module; only the Payments screen is gated by the shared 'finance.basic_payments' entitlement.
Customer quotations for work orders sit on the Finance screen and need both the finance and procurement modules.
The docs still use the name 'MIRFAQ One'; the running product name comes from config/branding.php ('H.M One').

limits.en: UAE eInvoicing is Setup Required: only a sandbox connector exists; no accredited provider, live exchange or tax reporting is connected.
limits.ar: الفوترة الإلكترونية الإماراتية «تحتاج إعداداً»: يوجد موصل Sandbox فقط، ولا يوجد مزود معتمد أو تبادل حي أو إبلاغ ضريبي.

limits.en: Payment gateway, SMS, WhatsApp, external storage and accounting integrations are shown as Coming soon and are not built.
limits.ar: بوابة الدفع والرسائل النصية وواتساب والتخزين الخارجي والتكامل المحاسبي تظهر «قريباً» وغير منفذة.

limits.en: Email delivery uses the hosting environment settings; approval emails are off unless enabled there.
limits.ar: البريد يعتمد إعدادات بيئة الاستضافة؛ وبريد الموافقات متوقف ما لم يُفعّل فيها.

limits.en: Subscription billing is manual: no online checkout; invoices and payments are recorded by the platform team.
limits.ar: فوترة الاشتراك يدوية: لا يوجد دفع إلكتروني؛ ويسجل فريق المنصة الفواتير والمدفوعات.

limits.en: Requesting a Solution does not activate it automatically.
limits.ar: طلب الحل لا يفعّله تلقائياً.

limits.en: There is no screen to edit approval workflows or their steps.
limits.ar: لا توجد شاشة لتعديل مسارات الموافقات أو مراحلها.

limits.en: Company logo and colors are set by the platform team, not by the company.
limits.ar: شعار الشركة وألوانها يضبطهما فريق المنصة لا الشركة.

limits.en: There is no self sign-up; companies and their first administrator are created by the platform team.
limits.ar: لا يوجد تسجيل ذاتي؛ ينشئ فريق المنصة الشركات ومسؤولها الأول.

limits.en: New roles cannot be created from the screen; only permissions of existing roles are edited.
limits.ar: لا يمكن إنشاء أدوار جديدة من الشاشة؛ تُعدّل صلاحيات الأدوار القائمة فقط.

limits.en: There is no audit-log viewer and no general document library for company users.
limits.ar: لا يوجد عارض لسجل التدقيق ولا مكتبة مستندات عامة لمستخدمي الشركة.

limits.en: Reports are fixed indicators; a report builder and advanced analytics are Coming soon.
limits.ar: التقارير مؤشرات ثابتة؛ ومنشئ التقارير والتحليلات المتقدمة «قريباً».

limits.en: File attachments exist only on leave requests, support tickets and employee documents.
limits.ar: المرفقات متاحة فقط لطلبات الإجازة وتذاكر الدعم ووثائق الموظفين.
